definitions.explanation: A tool with a heavy blade attached to a handle, used for chopping wood. Also appears in folktales and idioms.

examples.english: I split firewood with an axe.

examples.japanese: {木|き}こり⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{斧|おの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かついで⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: The woodcutter shouldered his axe and went into the mountains.

examples.japanese: {金|きん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{斧|おの}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{銀|ぎん}→銀：02651_gin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{斧|おの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{正直|しょうじき}→正直：01562_shoujiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: The story of the golden axe and the silver axe teaches us the importance of honesty.

notes:
USAGE:
{斧|おの} is the standard word for an axe. It appears in the well-known folktale {金|きん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{斧|おの}⟦{銀|ぎん}→銀：02651_gin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{斧|おの} (The Golden Axe and the Silver Axe), a Japanese adaptation of Aesop's fable about the honest woodcutter.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {斧|おの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}る→振る：01983_furu⟧: to swing an axe
- {斧|おの}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{割|わ}る→割る：02334_waru⟧: to chop with an axe
- {斧|おの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{研|と}ぐ→研ぐ：04377_togu⟧: to sharpen an axe

COUNTER: {本|ほん} (for the tool), {丁|ちょう} (traditional)
